resources.string: On the PC, open the tray icon → Settings → Phone App, turn it on, click \"Connect phone… (show QR)\", then tap Add PC here.
Waiting for usage from your PCs…
Account not identified — shown per PC
No quota data from the server yet
Can\'t reach the PC · retry in %1$d s
This phone was disconnected on the PC. Remove it and pair again.
Version mismatch — update the PC app and this app
Remove %1$s from this phone? To see it again, scan a new QR on the PC.
On the PC: tray icon → Settings → Phone App → \"Connect phone… (show QR)\".
Scan the QR. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi, have Tailscale on, or the PC must have \"Connect from anywhere (Cloudflare)\" on.
Point the camera at the QR on the PC
Opened the link for %1$s. Tap Connect to pair.
This isn\'t a pairing QR from the PC app.
The code is not valid. Show a new QR on the PC.
The QR expired. Show a new QR on the PC.
Too many wrong codes. Try again in a few minutes.
Can\'t reach the PC. Check the same Wi-Fi (Private network on Windows), Tailscale, or \"Connect from anywhere (Cloudflare)\" on the PC, and the firewall rules on the PC. %1$s
AI usage alerts from your PCs
Alerts from your PCs need a UnifiedPush app. Install ntfy (free, no account), then come back — it turns on by itself.
Off. Turn it on to get usage alerts from your PCs on this phone.
Via %1$s · registered on %2$d of %3$d PCs. No topic to set up: pairing by QR is enough.
Android is blocking this app\'s notifications.
Tip: if alerts arrive late while the phone sleeps, set ntfy\'s battery usage to Unrestricted.
Alerts are end-to-end encrypted on the PC (RFC 8291); the push server only sees ciphertext. When several PCs report the same event, it is shown once.
The push app refused the registration (%1$s).
The push app removed the registration. Turn push on again.
The push server is temporarily unavailable.
Usage will run out before the reset
Claude Code hit a usage limit
Forecast and warnings, if enabled on the PC
Checks GitHub Releases for a new version once a day and notifies you once. Installing only happens when you tap it: the APK is checked against its SHA-256 and handed to the Android installer.
Notifications are off, so new versions only show inside the app — allow
Version %1$s is available — see the banner on the Accounts tab
Couldn\'t check for updates. Check the network, or no update is published for this build yet.
Tap to see what changed and install.
Tells you once when a new version of this app is out
To install updates, allow this app to \"Install unknown apps\" in Settings, then come back.
Download or verification failed. Try again, or download it in the browser.

This copy was installed from a temporary (debug) build, so Android won\'t let it update in place. Uninstall it once and install the APK from the release page — after that, updates install from inside the app. Paired PCs need to be added again.
Show reset times as clock times
Off: \"resets in 2h 13m\". On: \"resets 3:20 PM\" (with the date when it isn\'t today).
Keep the screen on while open
For a spare phone standing as a usage display. Uses more battery; only while this app is on screen.
Choose this app\'s language in Android settings
Windows tray app for another PC (latest release)
Report a problem or suggest something
Opens a GitHub issue with the app and Android versions filled in

This app connects only to the PCs you paired — directly, or through a PC\'s Cloudflare Tunnel if you turned it on. No ads, analytics or usage tracking. Other outgoing traffic: the daily update check (GitHub) and end-to-end-encrypted alerts through your push app\'s relay.
